validity_notes: Frozen decision rule reached: NOT C1 -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID regardless of C2/C3. Per packet semantics, status=MEASUREMENT_INVALID and outcome=INCONCLUSIVE: the measurement transaction completed validly and the frozen rule was evaluated mechanically, but the frozen SNR model fails its own validation gate, so no scientific conclusion about the mechanism or full-DOM extrapolation is supported.

Root cause of C1 failure identified as model noise-scale mis-specification: the frozen SNR model uses the within-iteration within-type SE of the mean (~1e-5) as its noise term, but under template invariance this SE is near zero; the actual ranking-flip driver is the iteration-to-iteration variation of the margin (margin_std ~1e-4 to 6e-4) from role-subset and element-subset sampling. Phi(mean(SNR)) therefore saturates at ~1 while observed agreement is ~50-56%.

C2 pass via correlated-noise branch (rho=1.0) is not evidence of an independent instability mechanism: rho=1.0 is the mathematical consequence of template invariance plus the canonical recipe's shared role subset (same-type densities are scalar multiples).

The extrapolation (C3=false, predicting agreement >=80% at n=50) inherits the failed C1 model; it must NOT be used to justify Docker re-collection or the full-DOM experiment (EXP-INTEL-35462974425 remains unvalidated on this basis).

Small quantitative deviations from the parent run (e.g., canonical agreement n20 0.5654 vs parent 0.5595; DEF-FORM-ONLY 0.5137 vs parent 0.4934) arise from Python set-iteration order under PYTHONHASHSEED=0 affecting role-subset composition; they do not affect the C1 verdict (residuals ~0.44-0.50 are two orders of magnitude above the 10pp threshold).
Cart n=1 degeneracy confined to cart page_type (excluded from margin/SNR computations; listing vs detail used throughout per frozen measurement_validity).

Non-finite per-iteration SNR values (se_tot==0) were represented as +inf/-inf by margin sign and retained (not dropped); aggregates over finite values used for Phi(mean(SNR)) are documented in analysis_output_snr.json.

Outcome is INCONCLUSIVE, not a negative scientific result: the failure is the frozen model's own validity gate, evaluated mechanically; this is distinct from infrastructure failure (previous attempts here were transient retries) and from falsification (the claim is not resolved either way).
unresolved: Whether ranking agreement at full-DOM element counts (n=21-82) crosses 80% remains OPEN: the frozen model-based extrapolation is unreliable (C1 failed) and cannot substitute for the measurement.

Whether the actual instability mechanism is H1 (task-variance-driven flips), H2 (correlated noise from shared role subset), or H3 (persistent template invariance) is not discriminated: the frozen decomposition that would discriminate them failed its validity gate.

A corrected SNR model using across-iteration margin_std (not within-iteration within-type SE) as the noise scale might pass C1-equivalent validation and re-open the extrapolation question; this is outside the frozen design.

Whether a finer-grained alpha grid for the hybrid recipe (canonical/per-task blend) has a sweet spot (eta2>=0.80 AND agreement>=0.80) is untested (exploratory grid only, and hybrid blending was not part of the frozen decision rule).
